instructions:
Give yourself a leader key and your first mappings, in init.lua.

1. At the very TOP of init.lua (before any mapping):
     vim.g.mapleader = ' '
     vim.g.maplocalleader = ' '
2. Add these mappings (vim.keymap.set(mode, lhs, rhs, opts)):
     vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>w', '<cmd>write<CR>', { desc = 'Save file' })
     vim.keymap.set('n', '<leader>q', '<cmd>quit<CR>',  { desc = 'Quit window' })
     vim.keymap.set('n', '<Esc>', '<cmd>nohlsearch<CR>', { desc = 'Clear search highlight' })
3. Add one mapping of your own that you'd actually use. Ideas:
     keep the cursor centered when paging:  vim.keymap.set('n', '<C-d>', '<C-d>zz')
     yank to the end of the line:           vim.keymap.set('n', 'Y', 'y$')
4. Restart nvim and try them. List your leader mappings with :nmap <leader>

Read more: :help vim.keymap.set(), :help <Leader>, :help map-<cmd>
